verdict.rationale: Verbatim guidance content was retrieved from several revenue.delaware.gov pages, including the business-services, business-tax-forms and FAQ pages, and the probe record explicitly calls revenue.delaware.gov 'the open crawled surface.' Only the separate tax.delaware.gov filing portal sits behind a portal shell and authentication, and that is a transactional surface rather than the reading surface. The 404s on llms.txt, .md and openapi paths show normal server responses, not a bot wall. Missing for 10: an explicit probe of a guidance page recording HTTP status and user agent, and explicit confirmation of no CAPTCHA or JS-only rendering on those pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: revenue.delaware.gov remains the open crawled surface
To amend Delaware gross receipts tax or license/excise tax returns for ONE TAX PERIOD ONLY, you must submit the applicable Amended GR Return
